title: JUKI LBH-783
subtitle: 1-Needle Lockstitch Buttonholing Sewing Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI LBH-783 is a 1-needle lockstitch buttonholing sewing machine used to sew precise, uniform buttonholes on garments and textile products. It produces lockstitch buttonholes with a tacking stitch at both ends, suitable for shirts, blouses, trousers, jeans, jackets, and similar apparel.
applications: Lockstitch buttonholes on shirt fronts, cuffs, and collars
Buttonholes on trousers, jeans, and workwear
Buttonholes on jackets, blazers, and outerwear
Heavy-duty buttonhole work requiring reinforced tacks at both ends
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, shirt production, trouser / jeans production, uniform and workwear manufacturing, outerwear production

overviewDescription: The JUKI LBH-783 is a 1-needle lockstitch buttonholing machine that produces a complete buttonhole — side stitches, end tacks, and cross bar — in a single automated cycle. Buttonhole length is selectable via a gear-change method covering 6.4–38.1 mm, and the number of stitches per buttonhole can be set from 54 to 345 stitches. A 300 W general-purpose motor (250 W usable at ≤3,100 rpm) drives the head. The machine is lubricated with JUKI New Defrix Oil No. 1.

technicalSpecs.value: 300 W general-purpose motor (250 W usable at ≤3,100 rpm)

finalNotes:
• The LBH-783 sits in JUKI's lockstitch-buttonhole lineup between the smaller benchtop buttonholers and the higher-end LBH-1790 series. Compared to chainstitch buttonholers (e.g. LH-4 series), the LBH-783 produces a lockstitch side with bar tacks — more durable but slower per buttonhole.
